name: Durmaz Google Sites Repository Bridge

dataPolicy.direction: read-only from canonical public feed and sanitized registries to presentation layers

systems.macalyConvex: authoritative structured repository and authorization boundary
systems.github: sanitized public bridge source, integration manifests, version control, validation, and deployment artifacts
systems.googleSites: presentation consumer for approved public content
systems.googleDrive: protected source/reference document storage with independent sharing controls
systems.sharePointStaff: protected operational workspace package; live provisioning pending SharePoint Online licensing
systems.sharePointClient: curated authenticated collaboration package; live provisioning pending SharePoint Online licensing
systems.lovable: read-only source reference for verified reusable public patterns
systems.base44: read-only source reference; sensitive tax-operations data excluded from public distribution
systems.replit: read-only source reference; reuse requires verification and editorial review

publicationRule: Google Sites may display only public canonical records and prepared brand shells. Prepared destinations are never represented as live until approved content exists.
